review_description: From first contact to complete installation we couldn't fault Joe from SEA Solutions Australia. Joe was the most thorough out of the 3 quotes we obtained, fully explaining what type of inverter was best for our situation. Joe explained why we would benefit from a DC optimised system over a string inverter, because our roof is shaded for 2 months over winter. Joe was the only person who got up onto our roof to check exactly where the solar panels could be installed. He was also the only person to thoroughly inspect our house for the optimum positioning of the inverter.  SEA Solutions Australia supplied top quality solar panels & inverter & the installation process was seamless.  Joe walked us through the SolarEdge app & we love checking how much power we are generating.  They organised our grid connection for us with our provider. We are extremely happy with Joe & Lia's customer service & nothing is a problem if we have a query. We would highly recommend SEA Solutions Australia on every level.
Joe was prompt and clearly discussed our options, installation was smooth and tidy.Setup and explained operation well.

From start to finish all the gang at SEA Solutions were top notch . Only quote we got that the installer(Joe) actually came over to our place to measure up the rest wanted to do it by aerial photos . They gave us options and actually listened to what we wanted. Never once did they want to upsell . When Joe and Max came over they were extremely professional the left my property in the same condition they found it in. They showed me how the system worked and how the app worked. Had a little issue with the app, Lia worked until the issue was resolved. Would not hesitate to use Sea Solutions again so to Lia Joe and Max thank you for your work and patience with me. . Our system is all I was hoping for can’t believe how well it works . Our daily bills have drastically dropped it’s absolutely amazing
I have had solar nearly 2 years and it is the best thing l could have done. Price of electricity is increasing, I will add a battery when it becomes more affordable
The only company who came and walked my roof instead of relying on Google. Didn’t leave equipment behind when said would bring. Has been available for post installation questions.
Very happy with the service, advice and product received. The installers were friendly, knowledgeable and very helpful. Affordable and top service.

Joe was easy to deal with and patiently answered all my questions. The removal of my old system and the new  installation was all done in 1 day despite light showers.I will consider a battery in the future.
The salesperson was really informative and the system was installed within 2 weeks just before Christmas.
Could not be happier with the service, advice and product received. The installers were friendly, knowledgeable and very helpful. Affordable and professional service.

Joe took the trouble to come out and talk to us and understand what we wanted the solar to run, Our concerns re aesthetics. Plans for a future EV and whether we wanted/needed a battery. From the start of the project to the completion the communication with Lia and Joe was excellent and the quality of the installation very high.
took the time to come out and answer all questions. speedy and professional installation.
Highly recommend Sea Solutions. Quality equipment. Excellent service. Explained the options simply. They did what they said. All very easy.
Joe & Max were excellent there service was second to none and their product is very good.
Sale and quote process was factual and not any pressure.  Installation delayed by substantial rainfall but I was kept informed. Excellent customer service.
Sea Solutions were on time for the install, were very tidy and maintained good communications.They followed up and made sure everything for the battery install worked 100%.Recommended.
We had a zoom video call during the sales process and the sales agent took time to understand what I want.

Joe was fantastic from start to finish. He was always easy to contact and wasn’t pushy at all (which I really appreciated). He was also flexible in waiting until we had our meter upgraded.Would definitely recommend Joe and Sea Solar

Quotation process involved detailed on-site inspection, was informative, the design overcame tricky roof issues and addressed our needs.Decommissioning of old system and Installation of new panel’s and inverter was completed efficiently and to our satisfaction. Installer was polite and knowledgeable.Customer service was excellent.

After the quote he never rang to close the sale. I rang him after reviewing a number of quotes to accept the quote two weeks after his visit. All Green policy is not to visit the premises which I found to be unbelievable as my house had some unique issues, and they persisted to send emails trying to get the sale.I was surprised how good the after customer service was and to arrange for the smart meter
Easy, quick and informative - Joe and Lia at Sea Solutions were great, expertise with great customer service too!

Installed on time and by professional team.Good customer service with all queries answered promptly.Got three quotes and they were in the middle but sales guy impressed.Electrical savings were somewhat overstated but pretty close to my own estimate.Overall really happy with the investment and would highly recommend.

Instant response to Solar Quotes referral. On-site inspection prior to quotation. Openly Indicated potential system limitations such as shading. Efficient, timely installation and dealt with a few technical issues, i.e. two power boards. Arranged grid connection and installation of a smart meter. Upgraded from 6kw to 6.6kw system when quoted panels not available - at no extra cost.

Quoting was well above expectations.  Came to the house.  Answered all questions and provided clear documentation.  Involved us in the decision process by providing options and evaluations releative to our needs. Friendly, polite and very willing to discuss concerns.  We chose a 6.5Kw system - perhaps slightly more than needed at present.However, the design will enable a battery and an electric vehicle charger to be added later with no substantive changes needed to the system.The installation was booked and then follow-up calls confirmed timing.  Arrived as promised and did the job in one day.  Clean and tidy with all materials and removals.  The owner of the company was working on the site and made himself available to answer any questions.  System was activated successfully and the Solaredge App was installed on our laptop and phones - with immediate results.  The whole site was explained.The documents for the connection to the grid were already completed for us.  Again, these were explained and submitted by SEA on our behalf.  The new smartmeter was installed late last week.The whole operation was very competently handled by SEA.  We are more than happy to recommend them to anyone seeking to install a solar system.And many thanks for the recomendation from Solarquotes.  We had earlier tried several other suppliers and were most uncomfortable with the approach, the lack of detail and the willingness to engage.  All 3 of your recommended quoters were very good but SEA stood out.
On time, on the roof for quote-full explanation. Then did job to suit my availability, then the bloke who did the quote did the job

I am writing this in anticipation of getting them fitted. The hold up is on my part with strata but that should resolve shortly now the requirements have changed to 50% of the vote for a special resolution on sustainability.I have given a high recommendation because Joe was the only who got up on the roof and measured, showed me all the products and fittings, offered to attend a strata meeting to explain everything, provided all the details in a timely manner and was thoroughly professional in his approach.He explained the pros and cons of each system and why he would recommend the system l have chosen.I am fully confident that the installation would go without a hitch and if there any issues, they would be resolved quickly without fuss.I also liked how he monitored my system to resolve problems before they become an issue.
Very happy with the quoting process and installation.Joe was extremely helpful and was very Punctual and tidy.

We were extremely happy and reassured that the person who quoted the job and inspected the site was the person who installed the system.  Excellent and professional installation process and customer service.
HelpfulOn time and cleanPoliteCould not faultThe guys were prompt
Great product and the only person to quote that actually got on the roof to measure properly.
On-time neat and tidy fast install, with great customer service. Not the cheapest but I opted to for the service and so far have been satisfied

From beginning to end we had great service, information, and attention to detail.On installation day the whole system was installed electrics checked and tested and we were left with afully functioning system in 4.5 hours.Undoubtley there are cheaper systems availabler, but our choice was based on quality of product and the company providing the service.We would recommend this provider/supplier without reservation.

Contacted me the day of the inquiry, great customer service from small team. Very happy with explaintation of different systems. Installed within 2 weeks of deposit. Handled all the paper work for electric company and explained everything. Best experience, easy and supportive. Thanks Joe and the team

I can not speak highly enough of Sea Solutions, from quoting to completion of installation, they have provided service second to none.Installation: They turned up on time, completed the installation with no fuss, great job, looks amazing, cleaned up &  left the house neat and tidy. Very polite and explained everything, helped me set up the App on my phone, and explained in detail what to look for and what to expect. They have even helped with organizing connection to the grid after installation completed.I would have no hesitation in recommending Sea Solutions to anyone who is contemplating solar. Truly exceptional service.

Solar panels are a product you need to do your research on! Joe and the team at SEA Solutions were brilliant in taking the time to explain the technical side of how things worked and installed our panels without any issues. They worked within our budget and delivered a system that has seen us save hundreds of dollars since we had the system put in place.

Highly recommended the team at Sea Solutions. Superior customer service and product knowledge.  During the quote, the Sea Solutions went over my bills and explained the best system to go with based on usage. Set me up on the app to monitor usage. Install was punctual, tidy and Professional.
Good to work with you
